t: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Bonds (English Dubbed)
d: To save their village, Naruto and his friends set out to stop a new threat.

t: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Will of Fire (English Dubbed)
d: Four Kekkei Genkai shinobi disappear without a trace and Kakashi leaves the village.

t: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: The Lost Tower (English Dubbed)
d: Naruto gets caught up in an underground channel of chakra and is sent back in time.

t: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Blood Prison (English Dubbed)
d: Naruto's convicted of a crime he didn’t commit and is sent to the prison, Hozuki Castle.

t: The Last: Naruto the Movie (English Dubbed)
d: The moon approaches dangerously close! Naruto and friends set out to investigate.
A foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
